The Slightly Haunted Dollhouse

Hii! I was so stoked to see that this community existed because I am…

member318 5 hours ago 2 votes
Hii! I was so stoked to see that this community existed because I am OBSESSED with plastic, vinyl, and porcelain notes and smelling like a haunted doll! I thought I'd make a little post with some of my thoughts and findings from my sampling journey ^_^

I first have to shout out Kewpie Doll | Pearfat Parfum as being my signature scent. To me, that rubbery vinyl note is very strong and truly does smell like a dusty musty old babydoll. Though with the zingy green and herbal notes, it doesn't really read that "haunted." And I'm sure depending on skin chemistry you might get more green than plastic.

The closest I have gotten to the eerie plastic doll scent with the perfumes that I own is layering Doll Skin | Boy Smells body mist with Morute Martyr | Pierrot Perfumery. Doll Skin brings that strong plastic note, almost like a bendy barbie plastic, and Morute Martyr adds a very strange and haunted dusty vanilla note. It's very odd and eerie but the powdery vanillas truly scream Baby Doll to me.

I have also tried Doll Head | Hexennacht and the older version of New Doll | Amorphous. Doll Head doesn't really give me what I'm personally looking for. It's mostly a very strong baby powder/baby wipes scent with a background scent of like a wet, dank basement lol. It's def very evocative but I was hoping for more plastic honestly. I got the first version of New Doll before it was reformulated and it honestly just smelled like a strawberry and lemon cupcake. But I've heard good things about the reformulation and that it apparently smells more powdery, plasticky, and dusty.

I'm very interested in My Doll's Makeup | Ataraxia and Doll-Like Creature | Necros and would love to sample them one day! Has anyone tried either of those before? What were your thoughts? I'm also interested in hearing about any other perfumes with a strong plasticky note too! I've absolutely fallen in love with rubber/plastic/vinyl notes ^_^
